verdicts.criticalReason: The PR commits PNG files (desktop-1440.png, mobile-375.png) under '.eneik/records/', which directly violates the PR's boundaries (no commits under '.eneik/') and constitutes a blockable committed generated/build artifact.

concerns.text: The commit includes compiled frontend assets under 'src/main/resources/static/assets/', which might be better kept as gitignored build artifacts depending on CI/CD setup.
The effect triggering fetchBackendDocuments uses debouncedQuery, but doesn't handle potential race conditions if multiple fetch requests are inflight, though debouncing at 300ms mitigates this.
